claims.statement: Commute/Kirchhoff identities, complete-multipartite inverse and trace formulas, and generic exact edge scoring/optimization are published methods, not claimed discoveries.

For the specified integer damaged graph and at-most-one-unit-edge budget, precisely the a-1 u-incident A pairs minimize U when all parts are equal; otherwise precisely all internal pairs in largest original parts minimize. Allowing restoration does not change the set, and leaving H unchanged is strictly suboptimal.
At (3,3,3), U(H)=751/90; restoration changes U by -41/3150, incident-A by -1567/48825, and untouched-A/B/C by +31/3150. Thus an insertion can worsen U despite positive resistance reduction.
For a conductance-t insertion, the weighted U difference is (2t/n)[T-ms+t(rT-s)]/(1+tr). The strictly improving interval in the example is open; its endpoint gives equality.
The (3,3,3) untouched-pair weighted example has r=2/7, s=2/49, T=751/630, m=35 and upper threshold 1043/1322 for strict improvement.
